deicides.m: More than one deicide. deicide: the killing of a deity.

deifiers.m: More than one deifier. deifier: one who deifies.

deinstitutionalized.m: Past tense of deinstitutionalize. deinstitutionalize: to perform deinstitutionalization upon.

deinstitutionalizes.m: A form of deinstitutionalize, as in “she deinstitutionalizes”. deinstitutionalize: to perform deinstitutionalization upon.

deinstitutionalizing.m: The -ing form of deinstitutionalize. deinstitutionalize: to perform deinstitutionalization upon.

deionizers.m: More than one deionizer. deionizer: a device that deionises something.
